^(api_key_env)$.description:
The name of the environment variable that holds the provider's API
 key, such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: required in the API key mode, and
 refused in the sign-in mode. pumi run reads the key from it, which
 must not be empty.

^(read_paths)$.description:
Absolute paths outside the workspace that the commands of the adapter's
 harness may read, such as a toolchain or a module cache. The runner
 passes them in each invocation; pumi refuses a path that is not
 absolute (decision 0269).

apiKeyEnv.description:
The name of the environment variable that holds the provider's API
 key, such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: required in the API key mode, and
 refused in the sign-in mode. pumi run reads the key from it, which
 must not be empty.

executable.description:
The executable, relative to the directory of the configuration file
 or absolute (decision 0158).

readPaths.description:
Absolute paths outside the workspace that the commands of the adapter's
 harness may read, such as a toolchain or a module cache. The runner
 passes them in each invocation; pumi refuses a path that is not
 absolute (decision 0269).

sha256.description:
The SHA-256 of the executable, in lowercase hexadecimal. The runner
 refuses to start an executable whose SHA-256 differs.

pumi.config.v1.Check.jsonschema.json.description:
Check is a check program (decision 0272). The runner starts it with the
 process contract of the harness adapters, with no gateway and no model:
 one pumi.harness.v1.Invocation line on standard input and a
 pumi.harness.v1.Result on standard output, whose output is the check's
 output message (decisions 0158 to 0160).

executable.description:
The executable, relative to the directory of the configuration file
 or absolute.

sha256.description:
The SHA-256 of the executable, in lowercase hexadecimal. The runner
 refuses to start an executable whose SHA-256 differs (decision 0245).

pumi.config.v1.Check.jsonschema.json.title: Check

^(hard_caps)$.description:
The project's hard caps (decision 0147). When it is not set, pumi uses
 the default hard caps of its release.

adapter.description: Replaced by models (decision 0245). pumi refuses a file that sets it.

base.description:
The base of each invocation document: the component's name and version,
 the repository, the capabilities and the budget. The kernel sets the
 rest, and the input tree from the trunk (decision 0165).

checks.description:
The check programs, by the component name of the check, such as
 "spec" (decision 0272). Each check that the workflow starts needs one;
 a program for a check that the workflow does not start is accepted, so
 that adopters can name their own checks.

gateway.description:
Replaced by models (decision 0245): the API key variables are on the
 adapters, and the model roles are models.roles. pumi refuses a file
 that sets it.

hardCaps.description:
The project's hard caps (decision 0147). When it is not set, pumi uses
 the default hard caps of its release.

models.description:
The model configuration: the adapters, the model roles and the adapter
 of the external actions (decisions 0245, 0253 and 0272). It is apart
 from the profile settings.

project.description: The project that the plans are in.

trunk.description:
The trunk branch, such as main. Each plan starts from its tree at the
 time the plan starts (decision 0209).

workflow.description:
The workflow file that the plans run on, relative to the directory of
 the configuration file or absolute (decision 0167).

pumi.config.v1.Fallback.jsonschema.json.description:
Fallback is the adapter and model that a model role falls back to
 (decision 0246).
pumi.config.v1.Fallback.jsonschema.json.title: Fallback

pumi.config.v1.Gateway.jsonschema.json.description:
Gateway was the model gateway section, replaced by models (decision
 0245).

^(api_key_env)$.description:
The name of the environment variable that holds the provider's API
 key, such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. When it is set, pumi run reads the key
 from that variable, which must not be empty, and the gateway sends the
 key on every call. When it is not set, the harness keeps its own
 sign-in, and the gateway forwards the credential that the harness
 sends (decision 0225).

^(model_roles)$.description:
The model roles, by name, such as "frontier". Each model role that the
 workflow names must be here. A call that names a role goes to the
 role's model, and once to its fallback model when the provider answers
 with a usage or rate limit (decision 0233).

apiKeyEnv.description:
The name of the environment variable that holds the provider's API
 key, such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. When it is set, pumi run reads the key
 from that variable, which must not be empty, and the gateway sends the
 key on every call. When it is not set, the harness keeps its own
 sign-in, and the gateway forwards the credential that the harness
 sends (decision 0225).

modelRoles.description:
The model roles, by name, such as "frontier". Each model role that the
 workflow names must be here. A call that names a role goes to the
 role's model, and once to its fallback model when the provider answers
 with a usage or rate limit (decision 0233).

pumi.config.v1.Gateway.jsonschema.json.title: Gateway

pumi.config.v1.ModelRole.jsonschema.json.description:
ModelRole is the model and the fallback model of a model role (decision
 0233). Both must be in the gateway's price table, which lists only
 models of Anthropic's Messages API, and they must differ.

fallback.description: The fallback model, such as claude-sonnet-5-5.

pumi.config.v1.ModelRole.jsonschema.json.title: Model Role

pumi.config.v1.Models.jsonschema.json.description:
Models is the model configuration (decision 0245): which adapter and
 model serve each model role, and their fallbacks.

^(check_adapter)$.description:
The adapter that runs every external action, which names no model role
 (decision 0253), until epic E11 brings the forge adapter. Checks do not
 run on it: each runs as the program that checks names (decision 0272).

^(default_role)$.description:
The default role: the adapter, model and fallback of each model role
 that the workflow names and roles does not list. pumi refuses a
 workflow that names a role which roles does not list when this is not
 set (decision 0257). The circuit breaker keeps the state of each such
 role by its own name (decision 0264).

adapters.description: The adapters by name, such as "claude-code" and "codex".

checkAdapter.description:
The adapter that runs every external action, which names no model role
 (decision 0253), until epic E11 brings the forge adapter. Checks do not
 run on it: each runs as the program that checks names (decision 0272).

defaultRole.description:
The default role: the adapter, model and fallback of each model role
 that the workflow names and roles does not list. pumi refuses a
 workflow that names a role which roles does not list when this is not
 set (decision 0257). The circuit breaker keeps the state of each such
 role by its own name (decision 0264).

roles.description:
The model roles by name, such as "implementer". A model role that the
 workflow names and that is not here uses default_role (decision 0257).

pumi.config.v1.Models.jsonschema.json.title: Models

pumi.config.v1.Project.jsonschema.json.description:
Project is the project of the Cedar resource Plan (decision 0141), and the
 project section that the kernel adds to the task of every agent run
 (decision 0250). It is apart from the model configuration.

^(check_commands)$.description: The commands that run the project's checks, such as make test.

^(convention_files)$.description:
The files that hold the project's conventions, such as AGENTS.md,
 relative to the root of the repository. The task names a file that the
 input tree does not hold as missing.

checkCommands.description: The commands that run the project's checks, such as make test.

conventionFiles.description:
The files that hold the project's conventions, such as AGENTS.md,
 relative to the root of the repository. The task names a file that the
 input tree does not hold as missing.

pumi.config.v1.Project.jsonschema.json.title: Project

pumi.config.v1.Role.jsonschema.json.description:
Role is the adapter and model of a model role, and its fallback
 (decisions 0233, 0245 and 0246).

adapter.description: The adapter that runs the role's agent runs.

fallback.description:
The fallback, which may be on another adapter; none when not set.
 When it is on the same adapter, the model gateway also sends a call
 once to its model when the provider answers with a usage or rate limit
 (decision 0233). When it is on another adapter, the runner starts that
 adapter once when the provider's limit stops a run of the role, and the
 role stays on its fallback until pumi role reset switches it back
 (decision 0246).

pumi.config.v1.Role.jsonschema.json.title: Role

pumi.config.v1.Settings.jsonschema.json.description:
Settings are the profile settings that pumi reads from the file
 (decisions 0189 and 0201).

^(max_attempts)$.description:
maxAttempts by gate, by the gate's Cedar action such as planReview, and
 by "in-doubt" for the retry of an invocation in doubt from a state with
 no gate (decision 0044).

maxAttempts.description:
maxAttempts by gate, by the gate's Cedar action such as planReview, and
 by "in-doubt" for the retry of an invocation in doubt from a state with
 no gate (decision 0044).

parallelism.description: How many plans run at once across all tracks; 0 counts as 1.

pumi.config.v1.Settings.jsonschema.json.title: Settings

pumi.harness.v1.Capabilities.Network.jso.description: Network is the network access of a run.

hosts.description: The hosts, when the access is ACCESS_HOSTS.

pumi.harness.v1.Capabilities.Network.jso.title: Network

pumi.harness.v1.Capabilities.jsonschema..description:
Capabilities is the capability list of an invocation (decision 0159),
 neutral between harnesses. What the list leaves out, the run may not do.

^(write_paths)$.description:
The paths the run may write, as globs relative to the workspace. A file
 written outside them fails the invocation.

commands.description:
The commands the run may run, as prefixes such as "go test". An entry
 may begin with one or more NAME=value assignments, such as
 "GOWORK=off go test", and then allows that command with exactly those
 assignments: the entry "go test" does not allow "GOWORK=off go test",
 and no entry allows an assignment it does not name. Each adapter
 translates an entry as written (decision 0248).

tools.description: The kinds of tool the run may use.

writePaths.description:
The paths the run may write, as globs relative to the workspace. A file
 written outside them fails the invocation.

pumi.harness.v1.Capabilities.jsonschema..title: Capabilities

pumi.harness.v1.Component.jsonschema.jso.description:
Component is the component that an invocation runs, with its name and
 version (decision 0024).
pumi.harness.v1.Component.jsonschema.jso.title: Component

pumi.harness.v1.Input.jsonschema.json.description: Input is the input of an invocation (decision 0024).

^(base_tree)$.description:
The plan's base tree: the trunk's tree when the plan started (decision
 0209), or empty when the wiring gives no trunk. The runner puts its
 objects in the workspace's .git, with the ref refs/pumi/base pointing
 at it, so that a check such as the archive step can read the base
 (decision 0285).

baseTree.description:
The plan's base tree: the trunk's tree when the plan started (decision
 0209), or empty when the wiring gives no trunk. The runner puts its
 objects in the workspace's .git, with the ref refs/pumi/base pointing
 at it, so that a check such as the archive step can read the base
 (decision 0285).

task.description: The task, such as the prompt of an agent run.

pumi.harness.v1.Input.jsonschema.json.title: Input

pumi.harness.v1.Usage.jsonschema.json.description:
Usage is an amount of usage: of a budget, or what a run used (decision
 0136).
pumi.harness.v1.Usage.jsonschema.json.title: Usage

pumi.runner.v1.Invocation.jsonschema.jso.description:
Invocation is the invocation document: a self-contained record of one
 invocation, with credential handles but never secrets (decision 0024).
 The kernel writes it, and invocation.requested records its hash. The
 runner derives the harness invocation (pumi.harness.v1.Invocation) from it
 (decision 0158).

^(base_commit)$.description:
The trunk's commit when the plan started, whose tree is the input's
 base_tree (decisions 0313 and 0316), or empty when the wiring gives no
 trunk. It stays in the runner's document: the harness invocation that
 an adapter reads does not carry it. pumi branch writes the plan's last
 tree as a commit with this parent (decision 0314).

^(credential_handles)$.description:
The credential handles, which the runner exchanges with the credentials
 broker for tokens valid for this invocation only.

^(image_digest)$.description:
The environment, as the digest of a devcontainer image. The invocation
 runs in a fresh container from it.

^(model_role)$.description:
The model role of an agent run, from the workflow state that started
 it (decision 0233).

^(output_message)$.description:
The output schema: the full name of a protobuf message in the api
 module (decision 0160).

^(returns_tree)$.description:
Whether the result of a check carries the workspace's tree, from the
 workflow state that started it; the runner drops the file changes of a
 check without it (decision 0282).

baseCommit.description:
The trunk's commit when the plan started, whose tree is the input's
 base_tree (decisions 0313 and 0316), or empty when the wiring gives no
 trunk. It stays in the runner's document: the harness invocation that
 an adapter reads does not carry it. pumi branch writes the plan's last
 tree as a commit with this parent (decision 0314).

budget.description:
The budget in tokens, money and wall time. The runner stops the
 invocation at the hard limits even when it loses its connection
 (decision 0035).

capabilities.description: The capabilities, with the allowed paths (decision 0159).

component.description: The kind of component, with its name and version.

credentialHandles.description:
The credential handles, which the runner exchanges with the credentials
 broker for tokens valid for this invocation only.

imageDigest.description:
The environment, as the digest of a devcontainer image. The invocation
 runs in a fresh container from it.

input.description: The input: the repository and tree hash, and the task.

modelRole.description:
The model role of an agent run, from the workflow state that started
 it (decision 0233).

outputMessage.description:
The output schema: the full name of a protobuf message in the api
 module (decision 0160).

returnsTree.description:
Whether the result of a check carries the workspace's tree, from the
 workflow state that started it; the runner drops the file changes of a
 check without it (decision 0282).

pumi.runner.v1.Invocation.jsonschema.jso.title: Invocation
